# VS Code Extension

> Explore MongoDB data, prototype queries, and create Atlas clusters using the MongoDB extension for Visual Studio Code.

- [MongoDB Agent Skills in MongoDB VS Code Extension](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/agent-skills.md): The MongoDB VS Code extension includes the official MongoDB Agent Skills so you can perform common MongoDB tasks using AI agents.
- [AI and Data Usage Information](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/ai-data-usage.md)
- [Visual Studio Code Commands](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/commands.md): Explore available VS Code commands for managing MongoDB connections, launching shells, creating playgrounds, and navigating the VS Code Extension view.
- [Connect to Your MongoDB Deployment](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md): Connect to a MongoDB deployment using the VS Code Extension, with options for connection strings and advanced settings.
- [/docs Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-docs.md)
- [Export and Test Queries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-export-test.md)
- [/query Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-query.md)
- [/schema Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-schema.md)
- [MongoDB Extension for Github Copilot](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot.md)
- [Create an Atlas Cluster from a Template using Terraform](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/create-cluster-terraform.md): Create an Atlas cluster using Terraform with the MongoDB VS Code Extension, configure it, and manage it with Terraform commands.
- [Create Documents with VS Code](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/create-document-playground.md): Create documents in a MongoDB collection using VS Code by utilizing the insertOne() and insertMany() methods in a MongoDB Playground.
- [Perform CRUD Operations with VS Code](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/crud-ops.md): Use MongoDB Playgrounds in VS Code to perform CRUD operations on documents in a connected deployment.
- [Navigate Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/databases-collections.md): Explore and manage databases, collections, and documents using the MongoDB VS Code Extension, including creating, editing, and dropping data.
- [Delete Documents with VS Code](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/delete-document-playground.md): Delete documents in a MongoDB collection using VS Code Playground with deleteOne() and deleteMany() methods.
- [Enable Autocomplete for String Literals](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/enable-autocomplete-for-string-literals.md): Enable autocomplete for string literals in VSCode to automatically populate database and collection names in MongoDB playgrounds.
- [Export a Query or Pipeline to Language](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/export-to-language.md): Export and translate MongoDB queries and aggregation pipelines to programming languages with the MongoDB Extension for Github Copilot in Visual Studio Code.
- [MongoDB for VS Code Extension](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/index.md): Explore MongoDB data, prototype queries, and create Atlas clusters using the MongoDB extension for Visual Studio Code.
- [Install MongoDB for VS Code Extension](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/install.md): Install the MongoDB for VS Code Extension by searching for it in the Visual Studio Code marketplace and clicking Install.
- [Verify MongoDB for VSCode Plugin](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/install/verify-plugin.md): Verify the MongoDB for VSCode plugin by downloading the signature file, importing the public key, and using GPG to ensure the plugin is authentic.
- [View MongoDB VSCode Extension Logs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/logs.md): View logs for the MongoDB VS Code extension to help troubleshoot issues.
- [MongoDB MCP Server in MongoDB VS Code Extension](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/mcp-server.md): The MongoDB VS Code extension includes the MongoDB MCP server so you can interact with your MongoDB data from AI clients.
- [Create Databases and Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/playground-databases.md): Create databases and collections using MongoDB Playground in VS Code by following a template and running the playground.
- [Explore Your Data with Playgrounds](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/playgrounds.md): Explore and prototype MongoDB queries and commands using Playgrounds in VS Code, with features like syntax highlighting, autocomplete, and result editing.
- [Read Documents with VS Code](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/read-document-playground.md): Read documents in a MongoDB collection using the findOne() and find() methods in a VS Code Playground.
- [Use require() in Playgrounds](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/require-playgrounds.md): Utilize the `require()` function in playgrounds to import Node modules or local JavaScript files, enhancing code reuse and organization.
- [Use require() to Load Local Files](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/require-playgrounds/require-local.md): Learn how to use `require()` in MongoDB Playgrounds to load local scripts for code reuse, demonstrated with a document validation example.
- [Use require() to Include Node.js Modules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/require-playgrounds/require-modules.md): Learn how to use the require() function in MongoDB Playgrounds to include Node.js modules, both native and non-native, for enhanced functionality.
- [Run Aggregation Pipelines with VS Code](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/run-agg-pipelines.md): Run aggregation pipelines in VS Code using MongoDB Playgrounds to process and compute data results directly within the editor.
- [Visual Studio Code Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/settings.md): Explore configurable settings for the VS Code Extension, including shell selection, view options, problem limits, and connection saving preferences.
- [Create Time Series Collections with VS Code](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/time-series-collections.md): Create time series collections in MongoDB using VS Code by following a step-by-step guide in a MongoDB Playground.
- [Update Documents with VS Code](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/update-document-playground.md): Update documents in a MongoDB collection using VS Code Playground with updateOne() and updateMany() methods.
